id: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe (2005)

facts.why: The plot has the Pevensies reaching Aslan's camp and meeting him, with no feast there. The script has no feast and a web search found none.

facts.text: Sardines mashed with lemon and parsley on hot buttered toast, as he served Lucy.
facts.why: Tumnus promises Lucy a fire with toast, tea, cakes and maybe the sardines, and she agrees if he has sardines. The script does not show him serving the sardines.
facts.fix: Sardines mashed with lemon and parsley on hot buttered toast, as Tumnus promised Lucy.

vibe.verdict: One of the best of the batch: Tumnus's cave tea room, the lamp-post, Turkish delight and Father Christmas all land.
